cbinstall.name: Hotspots
cbinstall.author: Daniel Dimitrov
cbinstall.description: This Community Builder Plugin displays a map in the cb tab, with all hotspot markers added by of the user. More informations, download and more about hotspots you find at https://www.compojoom.com

param.name: hslimit
param.label: How many new markers to display
param.description: Specify how many new spots should be loaded for the users.

param.name: map_height
param.label: Google Maps heigth
param.description: Specify the height of the google map.

param.name: geocode
param.label: Geocode
param.description: Will transform the user address to lat & lng coordinates and will enter the user into the Hotspot db

param.name: geocode_field
param.label: Geocode field
param.description: If you have selected "use field" then specify the name of which field we should use here. Use a checkbox type for this field. 0 is disabled, 1(checked) is enabled

param.name: category
param.label: Hotspots category id
param.description: In which category should we add the users. (enter category id)

param.name: name
param.label: Hotspot name
param.description: This would be the title for each hotspot in this category. {user} is a placeholder for the user's name. You can use all available cb user fields with curly braces here.

param.name: description
param.label: Description
param.description: In which category should we add the users

param.name: delete
param.label: Delete or Unpublish?
param.description: If you've set the geocode option to "Use field", then here you can determine what happens when the user opt's out of the geocode feature. We can either delete or unpublish his hotspot untill he decides to opt-in again

param.name: address
param.label: Address
param.description: Select the column for the Address Field.

param.name: city
param.label: City
param.description: Select the column for the City Field.

param.name: state
param.label: State
param.description: Select the column for the State Field.

param.name: zipcode
param.label: Zip Code
param.description: Select the column for the Zip Code Field.

param.name: country
param.label: Country
param.description: Select the column for the Country Field.

param.name: custom_fields
param.label: Custom fields mapping
param.description: In this field you can speciy any custom fields mapping between hotspot and CB. Use the format hotspot_field=cb_field. Add each mapping on a new line!
